newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan rebels kill 24 soldiers in raid on camp.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan rebels kill 24 soldiers in raid on camp.

text.p: Tamil Tiger rebels overran a small army camp in Sri Lanka's eastern Batticaloa district early on Thursday killing at least 24 soldiers and wounding more than 70, military officials said.

A large number of Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels, fighting for a separate homeland, were also believed to have died in the attack on the Vaunathivu camp when troops, backed by air support, attacked withdrawing rebels, they said.
State radio said more than 100 LTTE rebels were believed to have died in air strikes on their positions after the raid.
The military spokesman was not immediately available to confirm the radio report.
Military officials said the rebels had blown up a bridge near the camp to delay reinforcements, which arrived almost 12 hours after the attack began.
